translations.c02: They are adopted pursuant to and for the purposes of arts. 4.3, 4.4 and 9.4, letter d), of the General Terms and Conditions of the Fleequid Marketplace (“GTC”) and constitute Special Sale Terms and Conditions within the meaning of the GTC (hereinafter also “Special Auction Terms and Conditions”), with the consequent prevalence over the GTC in the event of incompatibility and within the limits of the matters expressly governed in this document.
translations.c03: The publication of an Offer to Sell within an Auction qualified as a “1 Euro Auction”, as well as participation therein by Bidders, constitutes express, full and binding acceptance of these Special Terms and Conditions. The specific approval in writing, pursuant to arts. 1341 and 1342 of the Italian Civil Code, of the clauses indicated in the final section of this document remains unaffected.
translations.c04: The “1 Euro Auctions” constitute a particular category of Auction organised by Fleequid within the Marketplace, characterised by specific methods for determining the price and by specific financial terms as compared with the ordinary Auctions governed by the General Terms and Conditions (“GTC”).
translations.c05: In the 1 Euro Auctions, the ordinary mechanism for determining the Reserve Price (RP) based on the Minimum Commitment to Sell Price (MCSP) does not apply. The MCSP nevertheless continues to constitute the Seller’s minimum economic reference value pursuant to the General Terms and Conditions, but it is not used for the purpose of determining a Reserve Price within the 1 Euro Auctions, the economic protection of the Seller remaining governed, in the Commission Sale, in accordance with the methods specifically provided for in these Special Terms and Conditions.
translations.c06: Rules on the formation of the Binding Agreement.
translations.c07: In the 1 Euro Auctions, the Binding Agreement is concluded in favour of the Bidder who has placed the Highest Bid at the end of the Auction, in accordance with the methods provided for by the General Terms and Conditions (“GTC”), provided that at least one valid Bid has been submitted during the procedure. It is expressly understood that, in the 1 Euro Auctions, the conclusion of the Binding Agreement is valid and effective irrespective of the amount of the Highest Bid, even where the latter is equal to Euro 1 (one) or is in any case of a symbolic amount or significantly lower than the estimated value of the Vehicle.
translations.c08: Where at least one valid Bid is present, the Binding Agreement is concluded in accordance with the general rules provided for by the GTC, without prejudice to what is specifically provided for in these Special Terms and Conditions. The Buyer and the Seller acknowledge and accept that the competitive mechanism of the Auction constitutes an essential element for the determination of the price, with the consequent exclusion, within the limits permitted by law, of any objections relating to the fairness, adequacy or proportionality of the Sale Price to the Buyer.
translations.c09: Where, at the end of the 1 Euro Auction, no valid Bid has been received, the Auction shall be deemed unsuccessful and no Binding Agreement shall be perfected pursuant to the GTC; consequently, no obligation to purchase the Vehicle shall arise for Fleequid, the Seller or third parties.
translations.c10: Within the 1 Euro Auctions performed in accordance with the Sales Model of the Commission Sale, and by way of derogation from the Reserve Price (RP) mechanism provided for by the General Terms and Conditions, Fleequid guarantees the Seller, where at least one valid Bid is present, net proceeds, equal to the Sale Price to the Buyer net only of the Commissions payable by the Seller, not lower than the Minimum Commitment to Sell Price (MCSP) indicated for the Vehicle pursuant to the GTC.
translations.c11: Where the net proceeds referred to in art. 3.1 resulting at the end of the 1 Euro Auction are lower than the MCSP, Fleequid undertakes to pay the Seller the difference necessary so that the net proceeds due to the Seller, determined pursuant to art. 3.1, amount to the MCSP. Where instead the net proceeds are equal to or higher than the MCSP, the Seller shall be entitled in full to the relevant higher proceeds, in accordance with the ordinary rules of the GTC. Any economic top-up has a purely compensatory nature and does not constitute, in any way, a direct or indirect purchase of the Vehicle by Fleequid. The guarantee does not cover the Fees, the penalties, the reimbursements of expenses or the other amounts that may be owed by the Seller to Fleequid, which remain governed by the GTC, by the Fee Schedule and by the other applicable contractual sources and may be deducted or set off in accordance with the general rules.
translations.c12: In the absence of valid Bids and, consequently, in the event of an unsuccessful Auction, no Binding Agreement shall be perfected pursuant to the GTC and no obligation to purchase the Vehicle, nor any obligation of economic top-up in favour of the Seller, shall arise for Fleequid.
translations.c13: The guarantee referred to in this article constitutes an internal, ancillary and conditional contractual undertaking, limited to the individual Auction qualified as a 1 Euro Auction, and does not amount to a promise to the public, nor to insurance activity, nor does it constitute a general or permanent purchase undertaking by Fleequid. In any event, the disbursement of any economic top-up may take place only after the definition of the relationship with the Buyer, including the verification of the actual collection of the sums due or of the outcome of the default-management procedures provided for by the GTC. In the event of Cancellation of the Sale and of the subsequent sale of the Vehicle to another Bidder pursuant to art. 10.5 of the GTC, the guarantee operates, on the conditions provided for by this article, exclusively with reference to the new sale.
translations.c14: Fleequid’s right to suspend, cancel or declare the Auction invalid in the cases provided for by the GTC remains unaffected; in such cases the guarantee referred to in this article shall not apply, without prejudice to what is provided for by art. 6.2. The guarantee shall likewise not apply in the event of abusive, fraudulent conduct or conduct not compliant with the GTC by the Seller or by parties attributable to the Seller, including, by way of example, direct or indirect participation in the Auction for the purpose of influencing its outcome.
translations.c15: The ordinary commission structure provided for by the Fleequid Fee Schedule, as in force and published from time to time on the Marketplace, applies in general to the 1 Euro Auctions performed in accordance with the Sales Model of the Commission Sale.
translations.c16: The Buyer shall be charged the Commissions provided for pursuant to the preceding paragraphs, including, where provided for, the fixed commission (“flat buyer fee”) and/or the percentage commission on the Sale Price to the Buyer.
translations.c17: The Commissions accrue and are due as provided for by art. 12.4 of the GTC and remain subject to the general rules of the General Terms and Conditions regarding payment, invoicing and default, save as otherwise provided in these Special Terms and Conditions.
translations.c18: Save as otherwise indicated in the Auction data sheet, the provisions of the General Terms and Conditions regarding the Security Deposit, methods of payment of the Total Amount Due and the Buyer’s performance deadlines apply in full to the 1 Euro Auctions.
translations.c19: In the event of non-payment or late payment by the Buyer, the provisions of the GTC regarding default, termination, Cancellation of the Sale, penalties, retention and application of the Security Deposit pursuant to art. 6.3 of the GTC and compensation for damage shall apply.
translations.c20: In the event of suspension or cancellation of the Auction pursuant to the preceding paragraph, the provisions relating to the conclusion of the Binding Agreement shall not apply and the economic guarantee referred to in art. 3 shall not accrue nor be owed, without prejudice to Fleequid’s liability for wilful misconduct or gross negligence and to what is provided for by the General Terms and Conditions regarding Fleequid’s liability.
translations.c21: For any matter not expressly governed in these Special Terms and Conditions, the General Terms and Conditions, any Specific Terms and Conditions and the Fleequid Fee Schedule remain fully applicable, in accordance with the hierarchy established by art. 4.3 of the GTC.
translations.c25: Specific approval pursuant to arts. 1341 and 1342 of the Italian Civil Code
translations.c26: Pursuant to and for the purposes of arts. 1341 and 1342 of the Italian Civil Code, the User expressly declares that it has read, understood and specifically approved the following clauses of these Special Terms and Conditions:
translations.c27: (a) in its capacity as Seller: art. 2.3, second sentence (acknowledgement of the competitive mechanism of the Auction as an essential element for the determination of the price and exclusion, within the limits permitted by law, of any objections relating to the fairness, adequacy or proportionality of the Sale Price to the Buyer); art. 3.6, second sentence (disbursement of any economic top-up only after the definition of the relationship with the Buyer); art. 3.7, second sentence (non-assignability and non-transferability of the guarantee); art. 3.8, first sentence (non-application of the guarantee in the event of suspension, cancellation or declaration of invalidity of the Auction by Fleequid in the cases provided for by the GTC); art. 6.1 (Fleequid’s right to suspend, extend, cancel or declare invalid a 1 Euro Auction, including for duly justified organisational requirements); art. 6.2 (effects of the suspension or cancellation of the Auction on the conclusion of the Binding Agreement and on the accrual of the economic guarantee, without prejudice to Fleequid’s liability for wilful misconduct or gross negligence);
translations.c28: (b) in its capacity as Bidder or Buyer: art. 2.3, second sentence (acknowledgement of the competitive mechanism of the Auction as an essential element for the determination of the price and exclusion, within the limits permitted by law, of any objections relating to the fairness, adequacy or proportionality of the Sale Price to the Buyer); art. 6.1 (Fleequid’s right to suspend, extend, cancel or declare invalid a 1 Euro Auction, including for duly justified organisational requirements); art. 6.2 (effects of the suspension or cancellation of the Auction on the conclusion of the Binding Agreement, without prejudice to Fleequid’s liability for wilful misconduct or gross negligence).
translations.c29: This approval is independent of and separate from the specific approval of the clauses of the GTC, which neither replaces nor absorbs it.

notes: c09 e c12: l’italiano conserva il verbo «si perfezionerà» e cambia solo il soggetto; ho quindi mantenuto alla lettera la resa v1 «shall be perfected», sostituendo solo «Successful Bid» con «Binding Agreement». Nei paragrafi dove il verbo è nuovo (c07, c08, c20, c27, c28) ho usato la collocazione delle CG v9 EN «concluded / conclusion of the Binding Agreement». Ne risulta una doppia resa di «perfezionarsi» (perfected / concluded): se si preferisce l’uniformità, in c09 e c12 basta sostituire «perfected» con «concluded».

c10 e c15: «Modello di Vendita in commissione» non ha una resa congiunta nelle CG v9 EN; scelto «Sales Model of the Commission Sale» per conservare entrambi i termini definiti. Alternativa: «Commission Sale Sales Model».

c04: «specifiche condizioni economiche» reso con la formula della definizione di «1 Euro Auction» delle CG v9 EN («specific financial terms»), mentre «economica/o» già presente nella v1 resta «economic» (economic guarantee, economic top-up).
c11: «Tariffe» = «Fees» e «Tariffario» = «Fee Schedule» (v1). Tradotto con «Where» iniziale (refuso noto: «Qualora» caduto).
c02: tradotto «hereinafter also» (refuso noto «si seguito»). c09: «Binding Agreement» come termine definito (refuso noto).
c16: «Commissioni» maiuscolo → «Commissions»; «commissione fissa» e «commissione percentuale» restano minuscole come nell’italiano e nella v1.
c25: nessun punto finale in inglese, perché il punto dell’italiano è quello dell’abbreviazione «c.c.» (come nel titolo corrispondente delle CG v9 EN).

Incongruenze dell’italiano v2 (paragrafi non modificati, quindi non toccati in EN): preambolo [0~7] rinvia ancora all’art. 3.3 delle CG e ha «Condizioni specifiche» minuscolo, mentre il 6.4 è stato aggiornato ad art. 4.3 e «Condizioni Specifiche»; art. 5.2 conserva «Acquirente aggiudicatario» e «Prezzo di aggiudicazione» (EN «successful Buyer», «hammer price»), termini sostituiti altrove; artt. 3.5 e 5.4 conservano «regolare conclusione del Contratto» anziché Accordo vincolante.

Incongruenza IT/CG: l’art. 9.4 lett. d) delle CG v9 dice che le Condizioni particolari di vendita si applicano ai sensi dell’art. 4.5, e la clausola finale delle CG cita gli artt. 3.2, 4.5 e 9.2; il preambolo qui richiama invece gli artt. 4.3, 4.4 e 9.4 lett. d).
